title: soulangia thymifolia
intro: Soulangia thymifolia, commonly known as Chinese Thyme, is a flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This herb is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Soulangia thymifolia include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it beneficial for treating respiratory issues and urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of Soulangia thymifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
